title: Subarray Sum Equals K
hints: A sliding window needs the sum to grow as the window grows; negatives break that. Write sum(nums[i:j]) as a difference of two prefix sums P[j] - P[i].
So you need, for each j, the number of earlier i with P[i] == P[j] - k. 'How many times have I seen this value' is a hash map of counts.
One pass: running sum P, dict count with count[0] = 1 for the empty prefix; add count[P - k] to the answer, then increment count[P].
